# Trusted OSS

> A practical guide and toolset for trustworthy open source supply chain management.
> Built on ISO/IEC 5230 (license compliance) and ISO/IEC 18974 (security assurance),
> it covers everything from standing up a corporate open source program to
> automating AI coding and DevSecOps.
> The site is bilingual. English: https://trustedoss.github.io/en
> Korean: https://trustedoss.github.io

## Main sections (English)

- [Management system guide](https://trustedoss.github.io/en/docs):
  A step-by-step guide to open source governance built on ISO/IEC 5230 and 18974.
  Covers organization, policy, process design, SBOM management, vulnerability
  analysis, training, and self-certification.

- [AI coding guide](https://trustedoss.github.io/en/ai-coding/intro):
  How to make AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot
  comply with open source license and security policy automatically.
  Includes rules file templates (CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules) and CI/CD automation.

- [DevSecOps guide](https://trustedoss.github.io/en/devsecops/intro):
  Integrating SAST (Semgrep, CodeQL), SCA (syft, grype), secret detection
  (Gitleaks), container security (Trivy), IaC security (Checkov), and DAST
  (OWASP ZAP) into a CI/CD pipeline, with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI examples.

- [Reference](https://trustedoss.github.io/en/reference/intro):
  Policy templates, SBOM samples, and self-certification checklists.

## 주요 메뉴 (한국어)

- [체계구축 가이드](https://trustedoss.github.io/docs):
  ISO/IEC 5230 & 18974 기반 오픈소스 거버넌스 체계 구축 단계별 가이드.
  조직 구성, 정책 수립, 프로세스 설계, SBOM 관리, 취약점 분석, 교육, 자체 인증까지 포함.

- [AI 코딩 가이드](https://trustedoss.github.io/ai-coding/intro):
  Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Devin Desktop 등 AI 코딩 도구에서
  오픈소스 라이선스·보안 취약점 정책을 자동으로 준수하게 하는 실전 가이드.
  CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules 등 Rules 파일 템플릿과 CI/CD 자동화 포함.

- [DevSecOps 가이드](https://trustedoss.github.io/devsecops/intro):
  SAST(Semgrep·CodeQL), SCA(syft·grype), 시크릿 탐지(Gitleaks),
  컨테이너 보안(Trivy), IaC 보안(Checkov), DAST(OWASP ZAP)를
  CI/CD 파이프라인에 통합하는 DevSecOps 실전 가이드.
  GitHub Actions·GitLab CI YAML 예시 포함.

- [레퍼런스](https://trustedoss.github.io/reference/intro):
  오픈소스 정책 템플릿, SBOM 샘플, 자체 인증 체크리스트 등 실무 참고 자료.

## Tools and artifacts

Each tool runs in the browser with your own Anthropic API key, and follows the
page language (append ?lang=en for English).

- Rules generator: open source policy files for AI coding tools
- Workflow generator: DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline YAML
- SBOM analyzer: upload an SBOM, get a vulnerability response report
- SAST analyzer: Semgrep and CodeQL results turned into a remediation guide
- Secret analyzer: Gitleaks results turned into an immediate response procedure
- IaC fixer: Checkov results turned into corrected code

## Claude Code agents

Korean agents live under agents/, English agents under agents/en/.

- ai-coding-setup: analyses a project and writes tailored rules files
- devsecops-setup: analyses a project and writes CI/CD pipeline files
- sbom-vuln-analyst: SBOM vulnerability analysis report
- sast-analyst: SAST result analysis and remediation guide
- secret-analyst: response procedure for exposed secrets
- iac-fixer: corrected code for IaC violations

## Related standards

- ISO/IEC 5230: the international standard for open source license compliance (OpenChain)
- ISO/IEC 18974: the international standard for open source security assurance (OpenChain Security)
- SPDX (ISO/IEC 5962): SBOM standard format
- CycloneDX: OWASP SBOM standard format
